title: Optional write in a reverse-sweep configuration
statement: Let $A$ and $Q$ be types, let $x$ be a word over $A$, and choose a dummy state in $Q$, optional states $q,q'$, a valid input-head position $p$, an integer frontier $z$, two finite lists $l,r$ of optional symbols, an output word, and an optional symbol $b$. Applying the action that writes $b$ on the sole work tape, leaves its head in place, emits no output, and enters state $q'$ to the reverse-sweep configuration determined by $q,p,z,l,r$ and the output word yields the reverse-sweep configuration with state $q'$, the same other data, and right list $b$ followed by the tail of $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A dummy state in $Q$ is chosen
